5765.reason: addressed in v10: hotkeys on by default
5765.message: Video.js 10 does this: its built-in skins turn keyboard shortcuts on by default. If something's still missing there, open a [new issue](https://github.com/videojs/video.js/issues/new/choose) and link back here.

6335.reason: addressed in v10: time slider aria-valuetext reads times as words
6335.message: Video.js 10 does this: its time slider's `aria-valuetext` reads times as words instead of timestamps. If something's still missing there, open a [new issue](https://github.com/videojs/video.js/issues/new/choose) and link back here.

6336.reason: addressed in v10: time displays have phrase labels
6336.message: Video.js 10 does this: its time displays have an accessible label that reads the time as words. If something's still missing there, open a [new issue](https://github.com/videojs/video.js/issues/new/choose) and link back here.
